name: negotiate

on_enter.prompt: Say you are calling about a late payment and state each item from the facts in one sentence each. Then ask once whether the customer can settle everything now.

function.name: hand_off
function.description: Hand over to a person. CALL it when the customer insists on a person.

function.name: end_call
function.description: Ends the call. CALL it right after you said goodbye, with no other text.

extraction_schema.name: first_answer
extraction_schema.description: not_now when the customer says they cannot settle everything now, or names a date or amount of their own, else stay.

extraction_schema.name: topic
extraction_schema.description: difficulty when the customer says a life event stops them paying, else none.

transitions.description: A life event stops them paying
